dedupe_keys.name: vamonos flow through bridges experimental data

description: Cea, Luis and colleagues publish this resource through the source community. Thirty-two laboratory tests measure flow through four bridge configurations in a 15-metre channel with 0.5-by 0.5-metre cross-section. Coverage includes water-surface elevations at about 117 locations, raw readings, processed results and structure geometry. The source identifies calibration of non-hydrostatic two-dimensional hydraulic models and empirical rating-curve analysis as intended uses. Supporting Matlab scripts belong to the measurement package. This bridge campaign is distinct from the related VAMONOS weir experiments, although both use the laboratory programme. Zenodo supplies the deposited data and native file inventory with open access under cc-by-4.0. Sample values, linked files and code were not read or executed during source checks. A limitation is that complete implementation or measurement settings cannot be reconstructed from descriptive metadata alone. Related experimental components and publications retain their distinct roles; separate deposits are not assumed to provide independent observations.
